Appearance:
 Mr. Amit Dubey - Advocate for the applicant.
 Mr. Ravendra Shukla- G.A. for the State.
 Order
This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Surksha Sanhita.

2. The applicant is in custody since 17.2.2025 in connection with Crime No.236/2024 registered at P.S.-Bareli, District-Raisen, (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n),
109 of IPC and Sections 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
3. Prosecution story, in brief, is that applicant committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault on minor prosecutrix.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that prosecutrix and applicant resided together from 01.04.2024 to 16.02.2025.
On the date of incident, prosecutrix was aged about 16 years and 8 months.
No injuries have been found on the person of prosecutrix.
Applicant is in jail since 17.02.2025.
After investigation, charge sheet has been filed.
It is also urged that prosecutrix has no objection, if the applicant is released on bail.

After referring to statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 183 of BNSS, it is urged that it is a case of NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:12625 2 MCRC-10674-2025 consensual relationship.
The trial of the case will take considerable time.

Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail pending the Sachin Maskole vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34791412/
1 trial.
5.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the state has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant.
6. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, first bail application filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. Soft copy of this bail order immediately/forthwith be sent to applicant through concerned Jail Superintendent.
10. Certified copy as per rules.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE Hashmi Sachin Maskole vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34791412/
